name: r3-dispatch-audit-fault
_comment: B1 (dispatch r3): a manual STREGA command accepted by the radio whose actuator_log insert fails publishes only the first command_ack; status and the second ACK need the insert. Covers OPEN_FOR_DURATION, CLOSE and CLOSE_FOR_DURATION, with a control valve.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO irrigation_zones(name,user_id,timezone,zone_uuid,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ('Zone A',1,'UTC','0b8f6a3e-6c1a-4f61-9a43-2f1d8b3e9c11','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z');INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,created_at,updated_at,claimed_at,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,strega_model) VALUES ('A840410000000301','OpenLogFault','STREGA_VALVE',1,'2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z',1,'CLOSED','MOTORIZED');INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,created_at,updated_at,claimed_at,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,strega_model) VALUES ('A840410000000302','CloseLogFault','STREGA_VALVE',1,'2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z',1,'CLOSED','MOTORIZED');INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,created_at,updated_at,claimed_at,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,strega_model) VALUES ('A840410000000303','TimedCloseLogFault','STREGA_VALVE',1,'2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z',1,'CLOSED','MOTORIZED');INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,created_at,updated_at,claimed_at,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,strega_model) VALUES ('A840410000000304','Control','STREGA_VALVE',1,'2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z',1,'CLOSED','MOTORIZED');
CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_log BEFORE INSERT ON actuator_log WHEN NEW.deveui IN ('A840410000000301','A840410000000302','A840410000000303') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 actuator audit fault'); END;
